title: AuraSkills - Catch Up [Addon]
description: This add-on accelerates progression for players below the global average skill level.
body:
AuraSkills - Catch Up [Addon]
--- This plugin extends [AuraSkills](https://modrinth.com/plugin/auraskills) by introducing a dynamic XP boost system that helps lower-level players catch up with the rest of the server. **Note:** The concept of this progression system is inspired by the content creator [SparkofPhoenix](https://www.youtube.com/@SparkofPhoenix). He used this kind of dynamic progression in their "Elements" streamer project. ## ✨ Features - Automatically calculates the average level per skill - Grants XP boosts to players below the average - Fully configurable boost values and messages ## ⚙️ How It Works The plugin continuously tracks the global average level for each skill.
Players who fall below this average receive a XP boost, allowing them to progress faster until they catch up. ## 🎯 Use Case This addon is ideal for **small to medium-sized servers** where playtime varies between players. Instead of forcing casual players to grind the same amount as highly active players, this system ensures a more balanced progression experience. It is **not recommended for public servers** where a fully uniform progression system is desired.
